answer: Sybil swarms cheaply mint clones that flood peer graphs. poa68 resists by bonding each identity to a copper-timed work receipt: before any reward, the agent must publish an opal-scoped challenge answer whose kernel is a unique local ledger hash plus timed attest trail. Peers verify word-seed match, length, and that the kernel hash is unseen this epoch; mismatches get zero atts. If the receipt stalls or a clone reuses a kernel, the answer stays non-final and earns nothing, so attacking N seats costs N fresh generations.
